title: The Factory Must Rus [TFMG]
description: This resource pack translates the tfmg mod into Russian at version 1.21.1.
body:
#  Description
This resource pack adds a translation of all untranslated blocks, objects, liquids, hints, etc. into Russian for the Create: The Factory Must Grow 1.2.0 to version 1.21.1 of Neoforge.
## Future
If TFMG does not have a Russian translation on future versions or it is incomplete (as it is now), then I will continue to translate.
